verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada documents an email-or-mail fallback for incorporation using a PDF form, at $250 and 10 days. This sits alongside the online rail on the same fees page as an explicit alternative channel. The evidence does not show the exact mailing address, email address, fax number, or specific form identifiers the story asks for, so only the existence of the fallback rail is established. Missing for 10: exact postal and email addresses, any fax channel or number, named form numbers or links, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the paper rail works when online filing is down.
